description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee leave data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving a list of employee leaves with filtering, sorting, and pagination, but does not implement creation or deletion operations.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling employee leave data retrieval, including filtering, sorting, and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list employee leaves with filtering options, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception for creating new leave entries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; validation rules for create are not provided.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception for deleting leave entries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; validation rules for delete are not provided.

methods.name: getDefaultIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns default filter string for including employees.

methods.name: getDefaultStatuses
methods.description: Returns default leave statuses for filtering leave requests (pending approval).
